{{Quote|I'm saying that the being Thrawn of the First of the Chiss of the Empire of the Hand is not the great enemy that Nuso Esva has named him.|Jirvin, to Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Jirvin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quesoth]] [[Midli]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Jirvin was the brother of [[Trevik]] and he worked as the overseer of a group of Quesoth [[Worker (Quesoth)|Workers]] that serviced lighting equipment in the [[Red City]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], at the behest of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], Jirvin manipulated Trevik into acting as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Esva's rival [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], as part of a plot by Esva to attempt to deceive Thrawn.
